questions.stem: What effect does high oestrogen have on the levels of other hormones in the menstrual cycle?

options.text: It stimulates more FSH and inhibits LH
It stimulates both FSH and LH equally
It inhibits both FSH and LH
It inhibits FSH and stimulates a surge of LH

questions.explanation: At high levels, oestrogen inhibits FSH (preventing more follicles from developing) and stimulates a surge of LH from the pituitary gland, which triggers ovulation on approximately day 14.
